text: I've just reached the stand. What leaves for my town soonest?
Is there a departure coming up that I have not missed yet?
Please check which available bus starts nearest to the present moment.
I am checking the beginning of tomorrow's service, not the next bus now.
At the start of the service day, which departure comes before all others?
What is the first run listed for the whole date I chose?
If I arrive late tonight, when is my final possible bus departure?
The service day has an ending; what is its very last coach timing?
Which run closes the timetable for this destination on that date?
I have an origin and a destination; please show the buses linking them.
Can I see the departures serving travel from one of these stations to the other?
What bus services are listed for the station pair on my journey?
I will only be ready at 21:00, so find buses departing later.
Use my given time as the lower limit for leaving and show what remains.
Which coaches start on the later side of the departure cutoff I entered?
I have to set off by 15:30, so show buses starting earlier.
Use my given time as the upper limit for departure and show what remains.
Which coaches start on the earlier side of the leaving cutoff I entered?
I'd like to leave close to 13:20; are there departures near that hour?
Check a narrow departure window on both sides of 6:45 PM.
Rather than the next bus generally, find one leaving approximately at my chosen time.
What clock time does the schedule give for getting off at my destination?
Read the planned arrival entry for this coach at the station I am going to.
When does the published timetable say this bus gets there?
From getting on to getting off, how long is this ride supposed to last?
I do not need a clock time; I need the number of hours this trip takes.
What is the total elapsed bus-travel time for my selected segment?
Is there a valid operating run for this route on today's date?
For the present calendar date, which departures are enabled to run?
Please check today's running services using their actual operating calendars.
Can you work out the spacing of today's bus departures for this route?
What count of services and intervals between them does the timetable show?
How many times is a bus scheduled to leave, and how far apart are those times?
We are travelling during Sankranti. What special-date services are recorded?
I want the timetable for the holiday, including added or removed runs.
Does the selected festival date have its own local operating exceptions?
Before picking a particular bus, what coach classes can I select here?
Please list the service-category choices available for these two places.
What varieties of bus are recorded as serving the trip I want?
It is hot and I need air conditioning in the coach; find matching departures.
Please keep buses with an AC cabin and drop the rest.
Is there a service on this route using an air-conditioned vehicle?
I specifically want the cabin without AC; are any such coaches listed?
Please keep buses marked as not air-conditioned and drop the rest.
Can you find ordinary ventilation instead of air conditioning for this ride?
For the long ride I would like a bunk to sleep in, not just a chair.
Find a service whose vehicle includes passenger sleeping berths.
Are there coaches on this journey in which I can lie down?
For this ride I would like a chair-type seat rather than a sleeping bunk.
Find a service whose vehicle is a seater coach instead of a sleeper.
Can you limit the choices to ordinary seated bus layouts?
Does the route have any coaches that run on batteries instead of diesel?
For environmental reasons I want an electrically powered bus on this trip.
Find departures with electric vehicles assigned to them.
Can I plug my phone in while riding in that coach?
What passenger equipment and comfort features are listed inside this vehicle?
I want to know the onboard facilities of the selected bus, not the terminal.
I cannot decide on a class: how do the different bus categories differ?
Compare the features of the route's service tiers for me.
What is different about choosing one coach category over the other available categories?
Someone in our group uses a wheelchair; can you locate suitable bus vehicles?
Only show coaches recorded as providing wheelchair access for passengers.
Are there accessible assigned vehicles on the route I am asking about?
If every place were occupied, how many passengers would fit in this bus?
Read the full seats-and-berths capacity, without checking reservations.
How many passenger places does the assigned vehicle layout contain altogether?
Can I board once here and leave only at my destination without changing coaches?
I need the trip to stay on one bus from start to finish.
Which departures let me make this journey without an interchange?
Starting with the origin, read all the stations on this coach's route in order.
I want the complete stopping pattern for the selected service.
Can you list the service's route from its first stop through to its final one?
I only want a path to Nellore that goes through Ongole along the way.
Check whether the chosen town lies along this bus's route to my destination.
Please route the bus journey via the location I have specified.
Between the two ends of the route, where are the bus's scheduled halts?
I want to check a stop made partway through this coach journey.
Does the chosen station appear as a halt in the middle of the service's route?
Am I allowed to join this coach at that station on the route?
Show the stops where the selected service is permitted to pick passengers up.
I need a legal pickup stop for getting onto this bus.
Am I allowed to leave this coach at that station on the route?
Show the stops where the selected service is permitted to drop passengers off.
I need an allowed drop-off stop for getting off this bus.
There is no need for one coach throughout; find linked buses with a change.
Can I take a bus to an interchange and then an onward service from there?
Please arrange a feasible sequence of bus legs with enough transfer time.
Set aside the standard path and find another bus route to the same place.
I want to see different itinerary paths apart from the usual way.
If the normal route cannot be used, what other bus path could I take?
How many kilometres of this route lie between where I board and get off?
What is the recorded kilometre length of my chosen bus segment?
Measure this route by distance rather than by its journey time.
Is there any chain of local bus services that could get me to this town?
Check whether this destination has a feasible path from our present bus stand.
I want to establish if the bus network can reach the place at all.
For the coach I selected, what amount is quoted for my ticket?
I need to know the charge for travelling between these particular stops.
How many rupees is the ticket price for this service and travel date?
My priority is spending as little as possible on the ticket; choose a bus.
Which of the priced services gives me the minimum fare for the journey?
Please put the lowest-cost known option first for this destination.
My priority is a short ride; which bus has the lowest travel duration?
Choose the coach that completes the trip in the least elapsed time.
Please put the shortest bus journey first, measured in hours onboard.
What are the differences in ticket charges across the available services?
I want to compare the amounts paid for these two coach options.
Show how much each bus would charge for the identical travel segment.
Can another passenger fit according to the latest vacancy record for this run?
I want the remaining free places, not the vehicle's total capacity.
Does the recorded inventory leave enough vacant seats for our party of four?
Before I try to reserve a ticket, does this bus even allow advance reservations?
Is reserving seats enabled as a feature of the chosen service?
I only need to know whether a reservation can be made on this coach at all.
What recorded channel should I approach to arrange a ticket for this bus?
Explain where or how the operator lets passengers make their reservations.
I want the booking counter or purchase-channel instructions for this service.
I hold a reservation reference already; what state is that booking in now?
Please tell me if the bus ticket I previously booked is confirmed.
Has my existing reservation moved from a waiting state to a confirmed state?
Which terms determine whether and when I may cancel my bus ticket?
Please explain the ticket-cancellation conditions that this operator has published.
I want the rules about withdrawing my reservation, not whether the bus was cancelled.
Which policy determines how much of my bus fare can be paid back?
Please explain the operator's conditions for reimbursing a ticket payment.
If I request money back for this fare, what published refund rules apply?
What makes a passenger eligible for a cheaper concession ticket on this operator?
Are there reduced-fare rules for students or older passengers on this route?
I need the requirements for claiming a fare discount, not an assumed discount amount.
Before packing, I need the bus operator's baggage weight or quantity limits.
What policy says which bags and parcels a passenger can carry on the coach?
How much luggage am I permitted to bring along under the recorded rules?
Is there a recently verified report of where the selected coach is and how it is operating?
Give me its present tracked operating status rather than the departure schedule.
What is the latest live observation available for this bus trip?
By what recorded number of minutes is this departure behind its planned time?
I want the amount of lateness reported for the bus rather than its whole status.
Has the selected trip got a fresh verified delay, and how long is it?
Was this scheduled coach run removed from operation on the chosen date?
Check if the whole bus trip was called off by the operator.
I am asking whether the service is cancelled, not asking to cancel my ticket.
Read the current valid bay number allocated to this bus at the stand.
Which platform is officially assigned in the local record for that departure?
I need the service's departure bay so I know where to wait.
What fresh observation-based prediction says when the coach should reach this stop?
Read the still-valid ETA for this trip instead of the scheduled arrival entry.
I need the current estimated reaching time based on verified operational data.
Have observations logged this bus leaving the chosen station already?
I want confirmation of a real departure having occurred for this coach.
Is there a verified actual-departure timestamp at my selected stop?
Have observations logged this bus reaching the chosen station already?
I want confirmation of a real arrival having occurred for this coach.
Is there a verified actual-arrival timestamp at my selected stop?
Do active incident records show an interruption to the usual bus route?
I want notices about a diversion or road closure affecting this service.
Is anything recorded that disrupts the normal operation of this coach's path?
Do the earlier and latest bay records show that this bus was moved?
Please confirm a reassignment by comparing its old platform with its present one.
Has there been a change to the announced departure stand for this trip?
The ticket has service 6842 printed on it; find that bus record.
I want the service identified by this number, not a route search.
Use the number DEMO31 to retrieve the matching service in the catalogue.
While waiting here, what terminal facilities can passengers use?
Are water, toilets or waiting areas listed for the bus-stand premises?
Please show the passenger amenities in the station rather than on a vehicle.
I have an ordinary travel question; what is the station enquiry-desk contact?
How can I ask the passenger assistance staff at this terminal for information?
Where do I find the bus stand's general help counter details?
A belonging was left inside the coach after I got off; whom should I ask?
I am trying to recover something lost during my bus trip.
Which contact handles found items or missing possessions at this terminal?
I need to contact the company running the buses rather than this stand's enquiry staff.
Show the transport operator's own recorded website or contact channel.
How do passengers reach the bus organization itself using its listed details?
Help me work out where my platform is inside the terminal using the recorded zones.
What floor or hall should I go to for this departure bay?
I need location information to find the right part of the bus station.
Whom can I approach to register a grievance about this operator's bus service?
What local contact accepts a passenger complaint about a journey?
Please direct me to the recorded channel for reporting poor bus service.
What food is suitable for a young Labrador puppy?
My cat refuses to eat; what should I try?
How can I train a dog to walk on a leash?
How do I renew a passport that expires next month?

Can you check whether my visa application was approved?

Which boarding gate has been allocated to my plane?
How much is the airfare for a round trip next week?
What is the scheduled reaching time of my overnight train?
Is my railway berth still waitlisted or confirmed?
Which train has the lowest ticket price for this rail journey?
Has the evening ferry sailing been cancelled by the harbour operator?
What is the capacity of the passenger boat to the island?
Where is the cruise ship's boarding pier located?

Help me choose a university course in mechanical design.
Why does the fuse trip when I switch on the heater?
How do I replace a damaged power socket at home?
Which inverter can run a refrigerator during an outage?

How do I cancel a streaming subscription I no longer use?
Can you recover messages deleted from my email inbox?

How can I obtain a certified copy of a birth certificate?

Calculate the total interest on a fixed deposit.

Tell me the annual insurance cost for owning a school bus.
How does a rainbow form after rainfall?
Which country has the longest coastline in the world?
